title: Session Feedback System
description: Collect structured feedback from students after sessions to improve teaching quality and student experience

teacher.overview: Gather valuable feedback from students after each session to understand what worked well and what needs improvement.

request: At end of session, click 'Request Feedback'
Choose feedback type (Quick Rating, Detailed Form, Custom)
view: Filter by rating, date, or specific questions

feedbackTypes.description: Simple 1-5 star rating with optional comment
questions: How would you rate today's session?

tips: Request feedback after every session for consistent data
Keep feedback forms short to encourage completion
Make feedback anonymous for honest responses
Act on feedback - students appreciate being heard
Share summary of feedback and actions taken with students
Compare feedback over time to track improvement
canDo: Send reminders to students who haven't submitted
cannotDo: See who gave what feedback in anonymous mode
Request feedback for sessions from other teachers
bestPractices: Use quick ratings for every session, detailed forms periodically
Read all comments, not just ratings
Implement at least one suggestion per month and communicate it

available: Response rate (% of students who submitted)

student.overview: Provide honest feedback to help your teacher improve sessions. Your input shapes how future classes are conducted.

submit: After session ends, you'll see feedback request
Answer rating questions (1-5 stars or scale)
Write comments in text boxes (optional but encouraged)
Choose to submit anonymously or with your name
view: Check your submitted feedback in session history
See if teacher responded to your suggestions

tips: Be honest - anonymous feedback helps teacher improve without consequences for you
Be constructive - say what can improve, not just what's wrong
Submit feedback while session is fresh in memory
Don't skip feedback - your voice matters
canDo: Submit feedback for any session you attended
Submit feedback within deadline if set
cannotDo: Submit feedback for sessions you didn't attend
Submit multiple times for same session

helpful: "The pace was too fast during the calculus section. More examples would help."
"I loved the real-world examples! They made concepts clear."
"Could we spend more time on Q&A at the end?"
"The polls helped me stay engaged throughout the session."

commonIssues.solution: Check if deadline passed, ensure you attended the session, verify all required fields filled, try refreshing
Check session history for feedback link, ensure session ended, verify teacher requested feedback
Cannot edit after submission. Contact teacher directly if urgent correction needed
Think about: What helped you learn? What confused you? What would you change? Be specific and honest

whyItMatters: Teachers use your feedback to improve future sessions
Your suggestions directly influence teaching methods
Honest feedback helps everyone learn better
Anonymous option ensures safe, honest communication

anonymityExplained.description: When you submit anonymously, teacher cannot see who submitted which feedback
anonymityExplained.whenToUse: Sensitive comments, constructive criticism, fear of consequences
anonymityExplained.privacy: Your identity is completely hidden from teacher
anonymityExplained.recommendation: Use anonymous mode for critical feedback you might hesitate to share otherwise
